newsitem.title: UK: Domino Printing shares up after results.
newsitem.headline: Domino Printing shares up after results.

text.p: Shares in Domino Printing Plc jumped on Tuesday after the company posted a strong increase in annual profits and said sales were running above last year's levels in all its regions.
The shares were quoted up 34p at 310p by 0910 GMT.
Domino's pre-tax profits rose 78 percent to 9.2 million stg for the year ended October 31 1996, on sales which increased four percent to 109.3 million stg.
The dividend was increased by nine percent to 11p.
"These results show a strong recovery from the previous year," said chairman Peter Byrom in a statement, adding: "Sales are currently above those of last year in all regions."
He said Domino's new laser coding product had been well received and he expected it to contribute to profits for the first time in 1997.
